answer.origin: finance.yahoo.com, published 2026-07-01, reporting NN, Inc.'s late-June 2026 announcement; the original NN release date is not supplied
answer.note: The source is a secondary report of NN, Inc.'s own announcement that it is adding 47 machine centers for liquid cooling production at its Wuxi, China plant for NVIDIA AI data center racks, with NN stating that 100% of the new capacity is pre-sold under multi-year, multi-product awards and targeting US$80–US$90 million of accretive new business in 2026. For NVIDIA, this is a supplier-side lead rather than a disclosed NVIDIA purchase: it indicates that third-party liquid cooling capacity aimed at NVIDIA rack programs is being added in Asia and that NVIDIA-linked demand for such components is being contracted into 2026 and beyond, conditional on NN's statement being accurate. The stated 2026 target is NN's own business goal and an unconfirmed plan, not a reported result. The NN revenue and earnings projections and the unnamed analyst estimates describe NN, not NVIDIA, and inform NVIDIA only as context for supplier scale. The Russell Microcap index removal concerns NN's trading and does not bear on NVIDIA.
limitations: The source does not identify NVIDIA as a direct buyer or counterparty of the pre-sold awards; the NVIDIA link rests on NN's description of the end application, so the customer for the 47 machine centers is not established.
The identities of the multi-year, multi-product award counterparties, contract values, and volume or delivery schedules are not disclosed in the supplied records.
The US$80–US$90 million 2026 new-business figure is NN's target, not a reported result, and its attribution to NVIDIA-related racks is not separated from other business.
The original NN press release or filing is not among the supplied records; the item relies on a secondary finance.yahoo.com report with no original statement day.
Timing of when the 47 machine centers come online is not disclosed, so the effect on NVIDIA's supply in the covered period cannot be dated.
The NN revenue, earnings and fair value figures are third-party narrative and unnamed analyst projections about NN and carry no direct information on NVIDIA's financials.
follow_up: Retrieve NN, Inc.'s original late-June 2026 press release or Form 8-K to confirm the exact wording on customer identity, pre-sold share, and the US$80–US$90 million target.
Check NVIDIA's most recent 10-Q or 10-K supplier and manufacturing disclosures for any named liquid cooling or rack component suppliers, including NN or its Wuxi operations.
Review NN's next quarterly filing for disclosed customer concentration, award terms, and the commissioning schedule for the new machine centers.
Check NVIDIA public statements or supply-chain reporting on rack-level liquid cooling sourcing outside the United States and any export or trade restrictions affecting China-based production.
